parts.title: Linear Regression
parts.description: Predict, score, and fit a linear model in closed form and by gradient descent.

parts.title: Logistic Regression
parts.description: A numerically stable sigmoid, BCE loss, predicted probabilities, and the gradient.

parts.title: K-Means Clustering
parts.description: Pairwise distances, cluster assignment, centroid updates, and inertia.

parts.title: PCA
parts.description: Center data, build the covariance, find the top components, and project.

steps.name: predict_linear
steps.doc: Linear model prediction: X @ w + b.

steps.name: mse_loss
steps.doc: Mean squared error between predictions and targets (a float).

steps.name: linreg_normal_equation
steps.doc: Least-squares weights solving X w ~= y (X already includes any bias column).

steps.name: linreg_gradient
steps.doc: Gradient of the MSE (predictions X @ w) w.r.t. w: (2/n) X^T (X w - y).

steps.name: r2_score
steps.doc: Coefficient of determination R^2 = 1 - SS_res / SS_tot (a float).

steps.name: bce_loss
steps.doc: Mean binary cross-entropy; p are predicted probabilities in (0, 1).

steps.name: logreg_gradient
steps.doc: Gradient of mean BCE w.r.t. w given predicted probs p: (1/n) X^T (p - y).

steps.name: pairwise_sq_dists
steps.doc: (n, k) squared Euclidean distances between rows of X (n,d) and C (k,d).

steps.name: assign_clusters
steps.doc: Index of the nearest centroid for each row of X.

steps.name: update_centroids
steps.doc:
New centroids = mean of the points assigned to each of k clusters
(an empty cluster keeps a zero row).

steps.name: inertia
steps.doc: Sum of squared distances from each point to its assigned centroid (a float).

steps.name: center_data
steps.doc: Subtract the per-column mean from X.

steps.name: covariance_matrix
steps.doc: Sample covariance of already-centered data: Xc^T Xc / (n - 1).

steps.name: pca_fit
steps.doc:
Top-k principal components of centered data Xc.
Returns (components, explained_variance): components is (k, d) with one unit
eigenvector per row, explained_variance is (k,), both sorted by descending
eigenvalue.

steps.name: pca_transform
steps.doc: Project centered data onto the components: Xc @ components.T -> (n, k).
